results.title: Affirmation
results.overview: When Xavier meets Sebastien at a local cafe, he doesn't know how his first date after bottom surgery will go. As sparks fly in the cafe, Xavier decides to take his date to an unexpected location, where they share in a magical connection. Affirmation is the first film to feature a trans man with lower dysphoria who has had access to gender-affirming care.

results.title: Bayang
results.overview: Ayu (16) becomes obsessed with the beauty standards she sees in social media and magazines. Covering her mirror with notes about what it means to be “beautiful,” she pushes herself to change her appearance through makeup, dieting, and other painful efforts. As her reflection disappears behind these expectations, so does her sense of self. Overwhelmed, Ayu escapes to the beach, where an unexpected encounter with the girl she idolizes challenges her beliefs and reveals a different understanding of beauty and self-acceptance.

results.title: Cholbon
results.overview: A documentary on the legendary Yakut rock band "Cholbon"

results.title: Crackula
results.overview: In Moss Side a white vampire offers a black ex-addict immortality. A story about privilege, hunger, and the high cost of power in today’s world.

results.title: Beyond the Gateway
results.overview: Four college student friends break into the abandoned office of their missing professor, only to uncover blood-soaked rituals tied to a gateway from another world—unleashing an inhuman evil hungry for fresh blood.

results.title: The Quantum Leap of The Termites
results.original_title: El salto cuántico de Las Termitas
results.overview: An amateur "newcom" team that mistakenly registers for a national tournament. With no competitive experience and only four training sessions under their belts, twenty women from Maipú—aged 50 to 70—decide to travel to Santa Clara to compete against professional teams. What begins as a fun sporting adventure soon forces them to confront their own limitations and age-related prejudices.

results.title: Retruco
results.overview: In a seedy bar, a game of truco pits Vittorio against Amaro, a violent and domineering player. As the stakes and threats escalate, Vittorio activates a hidden recorder. The police burst in, revealing a trap set to capture Amaro.

results.title: Long Live Kong
results.overview: A gigantic gorilla travels to Hollywood to become a movie star. Once established as an icon, a powerful businessman offers him a world tour. Thus, the gorilla travels to Argentina in 1978, where he is last seen in Mar del Plata.

results.title: The Quiet Hour
results.overview: On a winter afternoon, with a storm about to break, Dani follows her cousins ​​Nora and Inés to a cube-shaped shelter in the middle of the woods. There, they perform a ritual to hold back the rain and save their friend—"the Presence." Dani must follow a set of rules for the ritual to succeed, but the moment Nora sacrifices an earthworm, she can no longer bear it and breaks the cardinal rule: never leave the cube.

results.title: Franca
results.overview: In a small town, Franca, a single mother, tries to hold onto her last remaining child, Juan, while society, the justice system, and her own past seem to conspire to tear him away from her. Left without child support and with her older children in the custody of an unfaithful ex-husband, she survives by stealing food, negotiating with lawyers, and enduring the judgmental gaze of a traditional town—as well as that of her mother, a flirtatious woman who, despite loving her, never fails to point out her mistakes.

results.title: A Season
results.overview: Eric, a young Bali based heir used to a life of ease, until Sonya’s motorbike collides with his car on a coastal road. Sharp, unpredictable, and playing by her own rules, Sonya pulls Eric into a relationship that blurs every boundary he thought he understood. As their connection intensifies, Eric is forced to face a truth he has spent his life avoiding: nothing lasts forever, not wealth, not pleasure, not even love.

results.title: Cash Cows
results.overview: In the criminal underbelly of society, it's survival of the fittest as two hitmen claim what's rightfully their boss', only to end in a fatal encounter for one.

results.title: Sepele
results.overview: After ignoring his friend’s warning about a psychopath on the loose, Denis finds himself hunted through the dark corridors of his own home. When Adit comes to save him, Denis begins to question whether he has truly escaped—or is trapped in his own fear.

results.title: Awakening: The Fight for Israel's Democracy
results.overview: When Israel is hijacked from within by extremist political forces, a group of citizens transform overnight into protest leaders. They embark on an epic struggle for their democracy - one that pushes the nation to the brink of civil war. Then war does break out, and the stakes rise even higher.

results.title: Suspect: The Road Rage Killer
results.overview: Examines the case of Tracie Andrews, who claimed her fiancé had been killed in a shocking road rage attack. After a disastrous press conference, she found herself accused of murdering him. Detectives revisited timelines, cross-checked statements, and tested forensic evidence and slowly, the woman who entered the station as a witness found herself at the centre of suspicion.
